sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: AMOLED dark theme
Replaces the dark theme background with pure black and can dim menus, bars and buttons.
Custom accent color
Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
Floating navigation bar
Adds optional floating navigation with adjustable blur and glass.
Hide layout components
Adds settings to hide the Help center, Spread the word and About sections.
Hide navigation bar on scroll
Hides the bottom navigation bar on scroll down and shows it on scroll up.
Hide promotional messages
Hides promotional banners, offers and pop-up messages.
Hide upgrade promotions
Hides the Upgrade buttons, upgrade prompts and the welcome offer after signing in. Plan limits still apply.
M3E loading indicator
Shows the pull to refresh indicator as the Material 3 Expressive shape-morphing loading indicator.
Material 3 switches
Shows switches in the Material 3 style with check and close icons.

sources.label: Unlock your digital freedom. Free yourself from Big tech Corporations
sources.author: Proteus
patch_list: Allow screenshots
Removes FLAG_SECURE from Proton Pass activities, allowing screenshots and screen recording.
Disable app lock
Forces Proton Pass app lock and biometric authentication into the disabled/authenticated state and prevents auto-lock timeouts.
Disable clipboard auto-clear
Forces the clipboard clear delay to Never so copied passwords and aliases are not removed automatically.
Suppress telemetry
Disables Proton Pass telemetry event dispatch, listeners and repository upload entry points.
Unlock Unlimited Plan
Forces Proton Pass Plus plan with all limits removed and paid features unlocked.

patch_list: Allow Screenshots & Screen Recording - Proton Pass (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Bypasses Android WindowManager FLAG_SECURE restrictions in Proton Pass, allowing you to take screenshots or record screens of recovery keys, 2FA QR codes, and credentials.
AMOLED Black & Declutter - Proton Pass (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Injects pure OLED pitch black (#000000) into Proton Pass vaults and hides Proton Pass Plus upgrade banners and promotional popups.
Unlock Pro Vaults & 2FA Authenticator - Proton Pass (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks client-side Proton Pass Plus capabilities: built-in 2FA TOTP authenticator generation, unlimited custom vaults, custom item fields, and disables upgrade lock screens.
